description: Middle Eastern cooking centers on baharat, rice, and tahini. Shared plates, warm spices, and balance of grain, legume, and herb.

attributes.micro_lesson: Toast spices, use yogurt and tahini for richness, finish with fresh herb and pomegranate acid.
attributes.shopping_tip: Sumac, zaatar, bulgur, chickpeas, and flatbread are pantry anchors.
flavor_building: Start with tahini as your cooking medium.
Season with baharat — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around rice as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Middle Eastern food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
